notes: FR-QPB-072 (revised; Decision Log D-29): the generated project's ONLINE VWorld layer now connects via QGIS's native WMTS provider against the capabilities endpoint URL (see qfield_builder.vworld.build_wmts_layer_uri/resolve_wmts_layer_details); 'url_template' and 'build_gettile_url'/'build_tile_request_url' remain configuration for the OFFLINE MBTiles per-tile downloader only (qfield_builder/vworld_tiles.py, qfield_builder/mbtiles.py), which is unaffected by this revision. The generic default_wmts_* values are used when a live VWorld capabilities query cannot be completed and no layer-specific fallback is listed. wmts_fallbacks preserves native connection values for layers such as Satellite, whose GoogleMapsCompatible/EPSG:3857 JPEG service must not be flattened to the generic EPSG:900913 PNG fallback. The 'layers' list here is only the fallback/default set (see qfield_builder.vworld.supported_layers) -- FR-QPB-071 (revised; Decision Log D-26) requires the authoritative layer set to be discovered live from the VWorld WMTS capabilities endpoint via qfield_builder.vworld.fetch_supported_layers. NFR-QPB-059: VWorld/MOLIT provider terms, quotas, and licensing can change and should be rechecked for each release.
